name: Sonnet macro/sector rotation
strategy: Rotate into rate-sensitive small caps, industrial/capex reacceleration, and dollar-debasement hedges (gold, EM) funded by trimming exposure to the extended AI-infra trade, keeping a large cash buffer earning 4% given crypto bear/AI correction risk.

positions.thesis: Small-cap Fed-cut lever had its worst week since entry (-1.68%) as surging Treasury yields pressured the broader tape; month remains marginally positive (+1.15%) so trimmed rather than closed, cut from 14% to 10% pending re-confirmation.

Industrial capex reacceleration had its worst week yet (-3.36%) as bond-yield-driven selling hit AI-capex-adjacent names broadly even though the underlying 'AI infra first dollars' narrative is intact; trimmed from 8% to 6% pending stabilization.

Debasement trade reaccelerated hard (+5.45% wk, +12.95% mo) on a Treasury repurchase/liquidity announcement weakening the dollar even as yields rise -- a genuine stagflationary debasement signal; sized up from 12% to 16% to press the reconfirmed trend.

EM/China rebounded from last week's worst week since entry to +2.88% this week and +3.65% over the month, the multi-month uptrend intact and unbroken; sized up from 8% to 10% as the pullback proved buyable.

reassessment_note: Weekly desk 2026-08-22: Debasement/EM legs reconfirmed sharply this week (GLD +5.45% wk/+12.95% mo on a Treasury repurchase/liquidity announcement pressuring the dollar even as yields rise; FXI +2.88% wk rebound after last week's worst week since entry) while the reflation legs reversed into red weeks as Treasury yields surged and hit the broader tape (IWM -1.68% wk, XLI -3.36% wk). TLT printed a fresh 22-year low, completing three straight losing months (-1.92% wk/-8.23% mo) with zero Fed-cut confirmation -- closing the hedge outright rather than continuing to bleed on an unconfirmed thesis. Rotating weight from the cooling reflation legs into the reconfirmed debasement/EM legs and lifting cash.
research_notes: Checked live prices/weekly-monthly performance for every held/candidate symbol via WebFetch (stockanalysis.com, Yahoo Finance, CoinGecko; WebSearch budget was exhausted for the session). Key findings: (1) Crypto: BTC ran $63k(8/17)->$78.3k(8/21, +~22%), SOL is +24.9% for the week to $93.81 -- a violent rally attributed to a "Treasury repurchase/liquidity" announcement, i.e. a debasement/liquidity catalyst, not a resumption of the momentum-breakdown thesis my R3 SOL-USD short was betting on. (2) R2 legs diverged sharply from last week's read: GLD reaccelerated (+5.45% wk/+12.95% mo) and FXI rebounded (+2.88% wk) confirming the debasement/EM thesis, while IWM (-1.68% wk) and XLI (-3.36% wk) reversed into red weeks as a broad bond-yield surge hit equities (explicitly hitting Nvidia/AMD/Broadcom/Meta too). TLT hit a fresh 22-year low (-1.92% wk, -8.23% mo, -6% YTD) -- three straight losing months with zero Fed-cut confirmation. (3) R3 legs: XLV (+4.33% wk/+8.97% mo, Moderna-led, explicitly "breaking out amid the chip bear market") and XBI (+5.29% wk) confirmed hard; XLF cooled (-1.17% wk); KRE weekly figure unavailable via the sources tried but no reversal signal found (1yr total return 23.6%). SMH is now genuinely down, not just cooling (-4.66% wk, -4.05% mo), unlike last week's ambiguous +0.88% read -- real confirmation for the mandate's semis/AI-capex short leg. XLY's confirming down-week reversed to roughly flat (-0.15% wk vs -1.38% last week).
